panels.title: Failure rate (%) — 5m window — alert fires at > 5% sustained 2m
panels.description: notification_dispatch_attempts_total is new as of v0.5-027 — before this issue, only a raw failure count existed (notification_dispatch_failure_rate_total, misleadingly named — it was a Counter, not a percentage), with no companion attempts counter to divide by. This panel renders no data until that change is deployed.

panels.title: Raw counts — attempts vs failures per sec
panels.description: If attempts/sec drops to ~0 while failures stay flat, nothing is being dispatched at all (a different problem — check the RabbitMQ consumer, not the failure rate). DeviceNotRegistered outcomes count as an attempt but never as a failure — by design, see NotificationDispatchService.dispatchPushWithRetry.
